title: KATSEYE Fans Are Lighting Up Their Wildworld Tour With Official Lightsticks — Here’s Where to Get Yours
summary: KATSEYE's Wildworld Tour got underway Tuesday, with the group's official lightstick playing a role in the shows' coordinated visuals.
contentText:

KATSEYE fans are bringing the “Flame” to the Wildworld tour , one lightstick at a time. The band kicked off their tour in Dublin, Ireland, on Sept. 1, 2026, before bringing the tour to the U.K. The group will continue across Europe before heading to North America , with their first show scheduled for Oct. 13 in Miami, Florida.

For fans attending these shows, the official KATSEYE lightstick is an essential concert accessory. So far, the group has released just one official lightstick, which debuted in 2025 and includes a lightstick, strap, dust bag, six official photocards and an oh-so helpful instruction manual. Known as the Eyelighter, the lightstick features a hexagonal star design inspired by each KATSEYE member and can sync with specific songs during live concerts and synchronized events.

The KATSEYE official lightstick combines a clear globe featuring the group’s signature cat-eye-inspired emblem with a sleek white handle. It offers color-changing effects, Bluetooth connectivity and concert synchronization, making it a fun way for fans to actually be part of the show.

Some venues may play instructions on the big screen before the show starts to help fans set up their light sticks. However, it’s best to set everything up in advance in the app before you leave for the show.

- Connect the lightstick to the app: Download the official KATSEYE lightstick app and connect your phone to the lightstick via Bluetooth.

- Set up concert sync: Enter your concert date and event details in the app.

- Update the lightstick: If you plan to follow KATSEYE on tour for multiple shows, you’ll need to update the lightstick through the app every time with each concert’s details. Make sure the batteries aren’t low before starting a new update, then select “Check Firmware Version” from the app’s main menu.
